about_the_game:
Step into the eccentric laboratory of Doctor Rulo with TapMazing, an engaging game where you guide Po-G, a whimsical slime hero, through a vibrant and challenging world. Inspired by scientific experimentation and slimy ingenuity, this game blends fun with strategic depth. Explore a lab brimming with surprises, where each tap reveals a new twist!

Gameplay and Modes

TapMazing combines skill and strategy across diverse game modes:

  • Tracks: Master smooth paths with no obstacles to hone your tapping precision.

  • Gauntlets: Tackle twisting routes packed with obstacles, demanding skillful navigation.

  • Scavenger Hunts: Hunt for hidden cookie pieces, split into four parts, within compact mazes.

  • Mazes: Conquer expansive mazes filled with obstacles, seeking a single hidden cookie.

  • More to Come: Anticipate future updates with exciting new modes on the horizon!

Each mode challenges your reflexes and offers a unique experience, suitable for players of all skill levels.

Difficulties

Doctor Rulo offers four distinct difficulty levels to choose from:

  • Slime: Perfect for beginners to learn the basics, where obstacles sting and electric gates can end your run.

  • Volt: Walls crackle with electricity, causing damage on contact—ideal for intermediate players.

  • Lava: Walls turn to lethal lava, instantly ending Po-G’s journey with a single hit, suited for experienced players.

  • Acid: Walls dissolve Po-G into acid, forcing a restart from the mode’s beginning—perfect for hardcore enthusiasts.

Customization

Personalize Po-G to reflect your style with a variety of customization options!

  • A vibrant color palette featuring shades like Amber, Vermilion, and Jasmine.

  • Unique skins and accessories to enhance your slime hero’s look.

  • Customize Po-G’s core to match your preferences.

  • More customization slots are coming soon!

Achievements

Unlock achievements by demonstrating your prowess!
